title: Critical Connections in a Network
constraints: The network is connected and undirected, with no self-loops or duplicate edges.
Every endpoint is an integer from 0 to n - 1.
inputFormat: Implement criticalConnections(n, connections). Servers are numbered 0 through n - 1; each pair [u, v] is an undirected edge.
outputFormat: All bridge edges as endpoint pairs. Pair order and endpoint order are ignored. Return [] if removing any single edge leaves the network connected.

visuals.title: Only edge 1—3 is a bridge
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 380 250" role="img" aria-label="Triangle 0, 1, 2 stays connected after one triangle edge is removed, but edge 1 to 3 is a bridge" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:380px;color:var(--color-text)"><path d="M70 40L70 170L200 105Z" fill="none" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M200 105H320" stroke="var(--color-danger)" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="70" cy="40" r="22" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="70" y="46" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle">0</text><circle cx="70" cy="170" r="22" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="70" y="176" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle">2</text><circle cx="200" cy="105" r="22" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="200" y="111" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle">1</text><circle cx="320" cy="105" r="22" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="320" y="111" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="190" y="225" fill="currentColor" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle">Remove 1—3: server 3 is isolated</text></svg>
visuals.caption: The triangle has alternate routes. Server 3 has only one connection, so removing that edge disconnects it.
